judgment.notes: The complete P in type-Check.lean quantifies over every n:ℕ and E:Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)), followed by exactly 0≤n, E.Nonempty and IsCompact E. These match the approved nonnegative-integer domain and H001–H003; n=0 remains available. E is arbitrary, with no measurability, regularity, dimension-positivity or finiteness hypothesis added. There are no external E theorem roots. The only contract premises are H001–H003; objects and shared_obligations are empty. The internal yCritical assumption in later workers is produced unconditionally by T001, rather than becoming an external hypothesis. After contracting implementation helpers, inputs are R001: library only; R002:H001,H002,H003,N001; R003:N001; R004:N001,N002,N003; R005:N002 plus direct library Tonelli; R006:N001,N002,N005; R007:H002,N001,N003; R008:N002,N004,N006,N007. All T inputs have earlier producers, and the final closure therefore requires only the three source hypotheses. Background notes supply no new ports.
